integrity: Analytic all-order proof and separately replayable finite exact-arithmetic checks. No independent external verification or formal proof certificate claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact ordinary unit-weight paths only (one vertex per player); no statement for weighted paths, cycles, trees, b-matching, or additive nucleolus. Prior general matching-game algorithms already compute these instances in polynomial time; this contribution is the symbolic parity classification and exact second level.
title: The nucleon of every unit-weight path matching game: a parity law and an exact second level
